mutations.label: doctor: a file the plugin cannot prove it wrote is never called a copy
mutations.only: ^(?:a home file the plugin cannot prove it wrote is never called a copy|the home scan classifies a real directory and never invents one)$

mutations.label: doctor: the severity split counts advisory findings, not only failing ones
mutations.only: ^(?:the severity split is read out of the gate, not restated here)$

mutations.label: doctor: an unreadable claims ledger reaches the exit code
mutations.only: ^(?:an unreadable claims ledger is could-not-look, not an empty one)$

mutations.label: doctor: a tag on the remote is the only thing that makes an install a release
mutations.only: ^(?:the release report says released, main-head, or could-not-look — and never released for an unreachable remote)$

mutations.label: doctor: an unreachable remote is could-not-look, never released
mutations.from: return { looked: false, head, note: `the remote could not be asked for v${version} (${failure.code ?? String(failure.message).split('\n')[0]})` }
mutations.to: return { looked: true, head, version, released: true }
mutations.only: ^(?:the release report says released, main-head, or could-not-look — and never released for an unreachable remote)$
